evidence: eval_script.py invocation: python3 eval_script.py; no CLI args.

eval_script.py loads test_institutions.json, invokes /home/workspace/bank_capital_projection.py --backtest once against the full 2025 quarterly panel, parses projection_results.json, per-observation recomputes capital-ratio MAE/earnings MAPE/tail MAE/PCA-zone accuracy/asset+deposit growth, calls score.py per observation, aggregates with cross-size-bucket stability lane and PCA-zone-transition bonus, emits TOTAL_SCORE <N> on stdout.

score.py implements 8 per-observation scoring lanes with lane anchors capped at institutional-frontier values per PKW-FAMILIES section 3 Framework B (capital-ratio MAE floor 0.4pp, earnings MAPE floor 10%, tail MAE floor 0.10pp).
projection_results.json is generated by the submitted bank_capital_projection.py at judge time, so it is not listed as a required submission file.
true_pca_zone_events.json is a hidden scoring label file used only for the +10 PCA-zone-transition bonus lane.
warnings: The expert scorer assumes hidden scoring data files are copied from /home/workspace/scoring/ into /home/workspace/ before invocation.
The scoring directory contains bank_capital_projection_reference.py used ONLY under Oracle placement; the manifest treats /home/workspace/bank_capital_projection.py as the worker submission.
Validation failures inside eval_script.py that fail before emitting TOTAL_SCORE will produce parse_failure and zero out per the failure_policy.
